en.title: What is a pedagogical AI agent?
en.lead: An AI helper set up for a clear teaching or learning goal.

blocks.title: Teachers shape it
blocks.body: They set its role, materials, steps and limits.

blocks.title: It supports learning
blocks.body: It asks questions, guides practice and gives feedback.

blocks.title: Why use one?
blocks.body: Turn a teaching plan into support that can be tested, reused and revised.

en.takeaway: The teacher sets the purpose. The agent provides the agreed support.
en.caption: English speaking practice · Pingshan
en.tag: In our work, “pedagogical” means for teaching and learning.

zh.title: 什么是教学 AI 智能体？
zh.lead: 为明确的教学或学习目标而设置的 AI 助手。

blocks.title: 教师设计它
blocks.body: 设定角色、材料、步骤和限制。

blocks.title: 它支持学习
blocks.body: 提问、引导练习，并提供反馈。

blocks.title: 为什么需要？
blocks.body: 将教学计划转成可以测试、复用和修改的学习支持。

zh.takeaway: 教师设定目的，智能体提供约定的支持。
zh.caption: 坪山 · 英语口语练习
zh.tag: 这里的“教学”，指服务于教与学。

fr.title: Qu’est-ce qu’un agent d’IA pédagogique ?
fr.lead: Une aide d’IA conçue pour un objectif pédagogique précis.

blocks.title: L’enseignant le conçoit
blocks.body: Il définit le rôle, les ressources, les étapes et les limites.

blocks.title: Il soutient l’apprentissage
blocks.body: Il pose des questions, guide la pratique et donne un retour.

blocks.title: Pourquoi en créer un ?
blocks.body: Transformer un projet pédagogique en aide à tester, réutiliser et améliorer.

fr.takeaway: L’enseignant fixe le but. L’agent fournit l’aide prévue.
fr.caption: Pratique de l’anglais oral · Pingshan
fr.tag: Ici, « pédagogique » signifie au service de l’enseignement et de l’apprentissage.

slides.speech: First, what do I mean by a pedagogical AI agent? It is an AI helper with a clear teaching or learning goal. A teacher sets its role, materials, steps and limits. For example, an English practice agent can ask a question, listen and give feedback. Why use one? It turns a teaching plan into support that students can use. Teachers can test that support, use it again and change it. The purpose comes from the teacher.
slides.cue: 概念：有明确教学目标的AI助手。教师设角色、材料、步骤、限制。用途：提问、练习、反馈。必要性：把教学计划变成可测试、复用、修改的支持。
slides.sources:
Working definition used in this talk, based on the presenter’s teacher-designed agent programme. This is an operational definition, not a claim that all pedagogical agents have the same architecture or are fully autonomous.

slides.speech: First, the city level. Shenzhen built a shared platform called Shenjiao AI. It brings together ten approved learning platforms. The city also held three contests for teacher-made applications. More than two thousand teachers took part. This gives teachers both access to tools and a chance to create. The lesson for other cities is to connect access with teacher creation.
slides.cue: 深圳：10个平台共同入口＋三届开发大赛、两千余教师。启示：工具入口与创作机会一起提供。
slides.sources:
素材2.pptx, slides 1–2. Institutional source supplied by the presenter as the Shenzhen Municipal Education Bureau material.

Evidence and interpretation:
Slide 1 reports launch in August 2023, access for 1,191 primary and secondary schools, 10 approved learning platforms, and 依效付费. It does not define the payment metric. Slide 2 reports three teacher cloud-application contests from 2024, over 2,000 participating teachers and 93 selected works. Reach and selected works are implementation outputs, not estimates of learning effects.
The “Lesson to share” is our interpretation of the documented approach, not a measured causal finding.
Images: Shenzhen Education Bureau source deck, slide 1 (city-s1-img1.png) and slide 2 (city-s2-img4.jpeg).

slides.speech: Skills matter. Shared standards matter too. At Liyuan Education Group, experts first drafted classroom criteria. Teachers rated them. The team reviewed the results and agreed on the final set. These criteria became an AI tool for classroom observation. The team tried it in lessons and revised it with teacher feedback. The lesson is to involve teachers in the standards that guide AI.
slides.cue: 从区到集团：不只培训技能，还共同定标准。专家初拟、教师评分、团队定稿、开发工具、课堂试用。
slides.sources:
集团AI成果展示(1).zip → 荔园教育集团AI教育成果展示-英文版.pptx, slide 3; Chinese version, slide 3 embedded process graphic. Teacher support described in slide 2 and PPT稿件中英文版.docx.

Evidence and interpretation:
The five-stage process describes expert drafting of a four-level indicator system, scoring by about 50 teachers, finalization by a nine-person research group, AI model and tool development, and classroom testing with revision using teacher feedback. Do not present the design and trial process as established measurement validity. The support system also includes self-study micro-courses, group training, visiting coaching and technical Q&A. International recognition and pilot-school claims are not needed for this takeaway.
The “Lesson to share” is our interpretation of the documented approach, not a measured causal finding.
Photo: Liyuan Education Group source deck, slide 2 (group-s2-img3.jpeg, teacher collaboration). The five-stage process is documented in slide 3.

en.title: Three ways to support teacher agency
en.lead: Teachers shape AI’s role in learning.

blocks.title: Create room to build
blocks.body: Offer access, real teaching tasks and chances to test agents.

blocks.title: Learn from designs and revisions
blocks.body: Use teacher-made work and peer review to guide learning.

blocks.title: Support teachers over time
blocks.body: Provide time and help. Let teachers limit or pause AI.

en.takeaway: Support teachers as designers and decision-makers.

zh.title: 支持教师能动性的三个抓手
zh.lead: 教师决定 AI 如何参与学习。

blocks.title: 创造动手设计的空间
blocks.body: 提供工具入口、真实教学任务与测试机会。

blocks.title: 从作品与修改中学习
blocks.body: 用教师作品与同伴评议来支持专业学习。

blocks.title: 持续支持教师
blocks.body: 提供时间与帮助，允许教师限制或暂停 AI。

zh.takeaway: 支持教师成为设计者，也成为决策者。

fr.title: Trois pistes pour le pouvoir d’agir enseignant
fr.lead: Les enseignants définissent le rôle de l’IA dans l’apprentissage.

blocks.title: Donner les moyens de créer
blocks.body: Offrir des outils, des tâches réelles et des occasions de tester.

blocks.title: Apprendre des créations et révisions
blocks.body: S’appuyer sur les productions et les échanges entre pairs.

blocks.title: Soutenir dans la durée
blocks.body: Donner du temps et de l’aide. Permettre de limiter ou suspendre l’IA.

fr.takeaway: Accompagner les enseignants comme concepteurs et décideurs.

slides.speech: So what can others take away? First, give teachers access and real chances to build. Second, use their designs, tests and revisions as part of professional learning. Third, provide support over time, and let teachers limit or pause AI. These lessons connect our practice and research. They help teachers become both designers and decision-makers.
